case_name: General Manager, State Bank of India and Others v Anju Jain
petitioner: General Manager, State Bank of India and Others
respondent:
Anju Jain
Supreme Court of India

25 August 2008
C.A. No. 5224 of 2008 Arising out of S.L.P. (civil) No. 8765 of 2007
The Judgment was delivered by : C. K. Thakker, J.
Leave granted.
1.  The present appeal is filed by the General Manager, State Bank of India ("the State Bank" for short)
holding: The appeal is allowed, the order passed by the Single Judge and confirmed by the Division Bench of the High Court is set aside and the writ petition filed by the widow of deceased employee of the State Bank for getting an appointment as dependent of deceased employee on compassionate ground is ordered to be dismissed.
